bio: Gravitas, a Michelin-starred restaurant in Washington, D.C., showcases Chef Matt Baker’s refined approach to modern American cuisine, built on seasonality, precision, and a deep respect for local ingredients. Opened in 2018 inside a converted Ivy City tomato packing warehouse, the restaurant blends industrial-chic design with a warm, elegant atmosphere that mirrors its balance of sophistication and comfort. The tasting menu changes frequently to highlight the best of the Mid-Atlantic’s farms, fisheries, and producers, offering dishes that pair striking presentation with bold, harmonious flavors—whether through vibrant vegetable-forward plates, pristine seafood, or expertly prepared meats. Baker, a James Beard Award finalist, emphasizes sustainability and craftsmanship, ensuring each course feels both contemporary and rooted in tradition. With its thoughtful wine pairings, polished service, and a dining experience that evolves with the seasons, Gravitas has cemented itself as one of the capital’s most compelling destinations for modern fine dining.
